description: Dedup fingerprints, capability discovery, agent binding, consent evidence, status transitions.

vectors.name: valid_agent_submitted_lead
vectors.description: Lead submitted by an AI agent with attestation JWT.

vectors.name: valid_status_transitions
vectors.description: Valid status transition sequence: NEW → PINGED → POSTED → ACCEPTED → CONVERTED.

vectors.name: ping_safe_dedup_hash
vectors.description: Ping with HMAC-SHA256 phone hash (64 hex chars) — dedup capable, not reversible without shared secret.

vectors.name: us_lead_with_tcpa_consent_evidence
vectors.description: US mortgage lead with Jornaya + TrustedForm consent evidence — uses generic consent_evidence[] array, not vendor-specific core fields.

vectors.name: ack_with_errors_array
vectors.description: Ack with multiple errors — demonstrates errors[] array for multi-field validation failure.

errors.name: MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD
errors.message: consumer.phone is required when no email or name is provided

errors.name: INVALID_TERRITORY
errors.message: state_region 'XX' is not a valid AU territory

vectors.name: event_unknown_value_open_enum
vectors.description: Event with a value not in the known enum — must be stored/passed through, not rejected (open enumeration policy).

vectors.name: lead_with_exclusivity_and_expiry
vectors.description: Exclusive lead with expiry — exercises exclusivity and expiry fields.

vectors.name: valid_ping_slots_available_v11
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §1: shared ping advertising remaining buyer-award slots to a v1.1-advertising receiver. Non-PII count on the strict allowlist.

vectors.name: valid_bid_slots_claimed_v11
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §2: single-slot claim (minimum 1, maximum 1) alongside accept; fulfilled at post award.

vectors.name: valid_post_contacted_hashes_v11
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §3: per-pair keyed contacted hashes on the post (phone-form only per the §9 gate); each entry 64 lowercase hex.

vectors.name: valid_contacted_event_report_v11
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §4: CONTACTED report on the open event enum (zero schema cost); details digest is the §3 phone reference digest (byte-exact, recomputable from test-vectors/sdk/contact-hash.json).

vectors.name: valid_post_contacted_empty_attestation
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §3/§4 absent-vs-empty: contacted_hashes [] is a positive attestation of no prior contacts and must validate.

vectors.name: valid_exclusive_single_slot
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §1: exclusive is exactly the one-slot special case — exclusive + slots_available 1 must validate under the conditional.

vectors.name: invalid_contacted_hash_sha1_40hex
vectors.description: LEP-0003 invalid example A: unsalted SHA-1-shaped 40-hex contacted hash rejected by the 64-lowercase-hex pattern; the reference network's invertible digest is never adopted (SPEC.md §9, §14 B3).

vectors.name: invalid_contacted_hash_short_digest
vectors.description: RF-1 defect class: a 63-hex string (odd-length/truncated digest) fails the ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ shape — the exact defect the ARB re-dossier caught in the record's own example.

vectors.name: invalid_contacted_hashes_over_bound
vectors.description: 101 contacted_hashes entries exceed the bounded post-direction maxItems 100; bulk suppression sync MUST NOT ride this field (LEP-0003 Deferred questions).

vectors.name: invalid_slots_available_zero
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §1: a platform MUST NOT send slots_available 0 — zero remaining means stop pinging; the schema minimum 1 rejects.

vectors.name: invalid_slots_claimed_multi
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §2/F4: slots_claimed 2 is out of range for v1.1 (maximum 1) — multi-slot agency claims have no delivery path and are deferred (#153 T5).

vectors.name: invalid_exclusive_multislot
vectors.description: LEP-0003 invalid example B (message-level twin of lcp-neg-exclusive-multislot-001): exclusive lead advertising 3 slots contradicts the one-slot special case; rejected by the ping schema conditional, not just by prose (#153 T7/F8).

vectors.name: invalid_slot_ping_to_v10_receiver
vectors.description: LEP-0003 invalid example D: slots_available toward a receiver advertising only 1.0.0. Schema-valid in isolation, but the capability gate (SPEC.md §8 parsed-semver membership, §4 send-time rule) forbids the send — the receiver's closed v1.0 allowlist would reject it, so this is a sender conformance failure.

vectors.name: invalid_contacted_report_over_ingest_bound
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §4: a CONTACTED report with 33 contacted_hashes entries exceeds the 32-per-report ingest bound — a conformant receiver MUST reject (validation rejection, not a store). Schemas cannot see this (event details are open by design), so the conformance runner enforces it.

vectors.name: invalid_contacted_report_empty_array
vectors.description: LEP-0003 §4: details.contacted_hashes [] MUST NOT be sent as an event detail ([] asserts nothing in the report direction; absent = nothing to report).

vectors.name: post_pricing_same_currency_fx_metadata
vectors.description: v1.2 D7: same-currency settlement carrying complete FX metadata. fx_rate is a plain decimal with at least six significant digits and no exponent; the rate never feeds the auction when native and settlement currency agree.

vectors.name: post_pricing_cross_currency_missing_fx_rate
vectors.description: v1.2 D7: a USD-settled offer whose price_cents are in AUD carries no fx_rate. The offer is non-comparable and excluded with this reason; it is never compared as raw minor units.

vectors.name: post_pricing_stale_fx_metadata
vectors.description: v1.2 D7: the rate is older than LCP_FX_MAX_AGE_SECONDS (300) at delivery and its absolute validity end has already passed. Both make the offer non-comparable.

vectors.name: post_pricing_fx_rate_exponent_rejected
vectors.description: v1.2 D7: fx_rate is a decimal string, never exponent notation. The post schema pattern rejects '6.8e-1' and the comparability rule reports it as malformed rather than coercing it.

vectors.name: post_pricing_mixed_fx_source_rejected
vectors.description: v1.2 D7: the auction compares against rates sourced from 'ecb', but this offer declares 'openexchange'. Mixed-source rates are non-comparable, so the offer is excluded with an explainable reason.

vectors.name: invalid_prohibited_otp_value_at_intake
vectors.description: A prohibited value reaches intake: the plaintext one-time passcode is carried in compliance.otp.verified_value. Authentication secrets are a prohibited family (docs/PII-CLASSES.md 'Prohibited values'), so the receiver refuses the value and names the field — it is never scrubbed and the message is not stored.
